statements.status_notes: @opentelemetry/core 2.2.0 is pinned to an exact version by the upstream OpenTelemetry SDK packages in this release line. The fixed release (2.8.0) cannot be selected for those consumers without also forcing the 1.x consumers in the same tree onto a new major line. Waiting for upstream to update dependency versions.
Updating the vulnerable dependency requires a major version update from 1.x to the fixed version in 2.x. Waiting for upstream to update the dependency.

Waiting for upstream to release a version that no longer requires the 1.x version.
